quotes.text: "The outgoing form should still be visible"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned manual-config scenario correctly awaits the first mutation promise for the Back control to show the Cancel localization ID. After clicking Cancel it assigns another backTextPromise for the Back localization ID, but does not await or otherwise consume that promise before checking the outgoing form and clicking Test again. The same omission remains in the accepted source through the task end. The outgoing visibility assertion does not assert the label returned to Back. Awaiting the second promise before retrying would make that intended asynchronous label expectation part of task completion. This is a scoped static completion gap, with no reproduced test failure or claim that the UI currently shows an incorrect label.
title: The Account Hub manual cancellation test never awaits its second label-change promise
